changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: -- Only exact, unambiguous active names may link legacy records. UPDATE area_zone a SET hamlet_id = h.id FROM hamlet h WHERE h.valid_to IS NULL AND a.hamlet_id IS NULL AND lower(trim(a.hamlet_name)) IN (lower(trim(h.full_name)), lower(trim(h.name))) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hamlet candidate WHERE candidate.valid_to IS NULL AND lower(trim(a.hamlet_name)) IN (lower(trim(candidate.full_name)), lower(trim(candidate.name)))) = 1; INSERT INTO area_zone(id, code, name, hamlet_name, hamlet_id) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), 'ADMIN-HAMLET-' || h.id, h.full_name, h.full_name, h.id FROM hamlet h WHERE h.valid_to IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM area_zone a WHERE a.hamlet_id = h.id); UPDATE area_zone a SET name=h.full_name, hamlet_name=h.full_name FROM hamlet h WHERE a.hamlet_id=h.id AND h.valid_to IS NULL; UPDATE household house SET area_zone_id = ( SELECT min(a.id) FROM area_zone a WHERE a.hamlet_id = house.hamlet_id ) FROM hamlet h WHERE house.hamlet_id=h.id AND h.valid_to IS NULL AND lower(trim(house.hamlet)) IN (lower(trim(h.full_name)), lower(trim(h.name))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM area_zone a WHERE a.hamlet_id=h.id); -- Keep legacy area IDs/assignments and ambiguous households. Never rewrite hamlet IDs by guesswork.
